usedFor: Deskpro holds your tickets and Google Docs keeps the notes, so “New Ticket” runs “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Ticket” in Deskpro, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new ticket is written into a doc tab, which gives the team a plain running log.

watchOut: “New Ticket” in Deskpro is polling, and “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can overwrite a tab, so pick add.
